sound.title: Reminder sound
sound.description: Al Muttaqin's signature sound when a notification arrives while the app is open.

hints.adhan: Madinah-style adhan at prayer time; signature jingle for other reminders
hints.chime: A signature jingle in maqam Hijaz for every notification

sound.volumeHint: On iPhone the volume follows the side buttons.
sound.foregroundNote: While the app is open, every notification (adhan, Jumuah, announcements) plays the signature sound above right on time, with a Stop button. Browsers only allow sound after you tap the app once each time you open it, so tap anywhere after opening it. Opening the app after the adhan time never plays the adhan.
sound.backgroundNote: When the app is closed, your phone shows one notification per prayer time with its standard notification sound. Browsers (Android and iPhone) do not allow a custom sound such as the adhan for background notifications. On iPhone, notifications need the app added to the Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or later).
